oak_confounder.issue: Source/receiver endpoints are selected by graph diameter, but equal graph budgets do not imply equal physical transmitter-receiver geometry or distance.
oak_confounder.consequence: The ranking is not a fair WPT geometry comparison and cannot support a physical topology-performance claim.
oak_confounder.reusable_constraint: Future WPT courts must fix or explicitly parameterize 3D source/receiver geometry, coil orientation, separation, conductor budget, and coupling extraction before comparing efficiency.

next_gates: introduce explicit 3D node coordinates and matched source-receiver separation
derive edge coupling from geometry instead of uniform k
match conductor/component budget and resonator size
cross-check network result against an independent SPICE-like formulation
promote only surviving candidates to FEM/Maxwell
